integrity: Two source-complete, standard-library-only verification programs were run from the packaged paths and checked against the displayed integral Morse boundary data; mathematical correctness is based on exhaustive finite computations and the accompanying topological argument, not external certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact integral homotopy classifications are proved only for four finite parameters n=3,4,5,6; no claim for n>=7 or all-width torsion patterns. Literature priority may be limited by unindexed or unpublished work.
title: Moore-space summands in bidirected complete-bipartite multipath complexes
